title: Deskflow: free Synergy alternative
caption:
Synergy charges $15 one-time. Deskflow shares one keyboard and mouse across your computers for free 🖱️

✅ Control several computers with one keyboard and mouse
✅ Copy on one computer, paste on another
✅ Every connection is encrypted by default
✅ No subscription, no account, 100% free

💻 Mac · Windows · Linux
ℹ️ The Mac build is unsigned, so the first launch needs one quick Terminal command from the README, plus Accessibility access

Comment "MOUSE" and I'll DM you the link 🔗
